source: Surgery Board Question Bank -- 7th Month 2018 Course, Question 47 of 53
question: Thyroid gland facts — EXCEPT
question_ar: كل ما يلي صحيح عن الغدة الدرقية ما عدا

options.text: Thyroid gland is one of the largest endocrine glands
Thyroid gland consists of 2 lobes (right, left ), isthmus, and pyramidal lobe in 50% of the population
Hormones secreted by the thyroid are not affected by the pituitary gland
Thyroid gland has 2 arteries and 3 veins
The thyroid gland develops at 4 week of gestation

correct_text: Hormones secreted by the thyroid are not affected by the pituitary gland
purpose_ar: تأكيد أن إفراز هرمونات الدرقية يخضع بشكل مباشر لتحكم الغدة النخامية عبر TSH ضمن محور الوطاء-النخامى-الدرقية، وأن العبارة التي تنفي ذلك خاطئة.
trap_ar: قد تبدو العبارة C "لا تتأثر هرمونات الدرقية بالنخامى" غريبة بما يكفي ليشك الطالب فيها، لكن سهولة الخيارات الأخرى (كعدد الفصوص أو الشرايين) قد تصرف انتباهه عنها كإجابة واضحة.
summary_ar: إفراز هرمون الدرقية يخضع فعليًا لتحكم الغدة النخامية عبر TSH — هذا هو محور الوطاء-النخامى-الدرقية بأكمله، لذا العبارة خاطئة.

scenes.narration: لنراجع الخيارات الخاطئة واحدًا واحدًا. الخيار A، Thyroid gland is one of the largest endocrine glands: لا يتوافق مع معطيات هذا السؤال؛ الإجابة الصحيحة هي Hormones secreted by the thyroid are not affected by the pituitary gland. يصبح صحيحًا في سؤال يصف Being one of the largest endocrine glands, consisting of two lobes, an isthmus, and a pyramidal lobe in 50% of the population, having two arteries and three veins, and developing embryologically at week 4 are all correct statements. الخيار B، Thyroid gland consists of 2 lobes (right, left ), isthmus, and pyramidal lobe in 50% of the population: لا يتوافق مع معطيات هذا السؤال؛ الإجابة الصحيحة هي Hormones secreted by the thyroid are not affected by the pituitary gland. يصبح صحيحًا في سؤال يصف Being one of the largest endocrine glands, consisting of two lobes, an isthmus, and a pyramidal lobe in 50% of the population, having two arteries and three veins, and developing embryologically at week 4 are all correct statements. الخيار D، Thyroid gland has 2 arteries and 3 veins: لا يتوافق مع معطيات هذا السؤال؛ الإجابة الصحيحة هي Hormones secreted by the thyroid are not affected by the pituitary gland. يصبح صحيحًا في سؤال يصف Being one of the largest endocrine glands, consisting of two lobes, an isthmus, and a pyramidal lobe in 50% of the population, having two arteries and three veins, and developing embryologically at week 4 are all correct statements. الخيار E، The thyroid gland develops at 4 week of gestation: لا يتوافق مع معطيات هذا السؤال؛ الإجابة الصحيحة هي Hormones secreted by the thyroid are not affected by the pituitary gland. يصبح صحيحًا في سؤال يصف The thyroid having 2 lobes, isthmus, and a pyramidal lobe in 50% of people, having 2 arteries and 3 veins, and developing at week 4 of gestation are all true anatomical facts, unlike the false claim that thyroid hormones are unaffected by the pituitary, which ignores the TSH feedback axis.
